paragraphs: Aladtec is scheduling software for agencies that have to staff every hour of the day. It is sold under TimeClock Plus, LLC, which trades as TCP Software.

Schedules are built on rotational shift patterns, and open shifts are filled automatically so coverage holds. Work, union and fatigue rules are written into each schedule, which is the basis of the audit readiness claim. Reporting is meant to show where labor dollars go as overtime accumulates. Staff see their own schedules and handle trades and pickups themselves.

One testimonial on the page is credited to Manassas Park Fire and Rescue. A resource listed on the page describes the Minnesota Department of Corrections scheduling across nine facilities. Government and public safety appears as one of the industries the site asks about.

quote.text: Public safety scheduling software built for 24/7 agencies
